title: Automation Test Engineer
description:
About Us

App Successor Media Private Limited is a digital marketing and app development company in India with a history dating back to 2015\. Initially focused on helping businesses attract new users to their mobile applications, the company has since expanded its services to include mobile app development.

**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/appsuccessor

**Job Title:** Automation Test Engineer  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Location:** Noida

**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday (Second and Fourth Saturdays Off)

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for Android and iOS applications using Appium, WebDriver, and native automation frameworks.
* Analyze requirements and prepare test cases, scenarios, and documentation.
* Perform API testing using Postman, REST APIs, JSON, and HTTP methods.
* Use Android Studio, ADB, Xcode, iOS Simulator, and Android Emulator for testing and debugging.
* Maintain automation frameworks and improve test coverage, reliability, and execution efficiency.
* Identify and report defects and collaborate with developers, QA, UI/UX, and product teams to ensure application quality.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in app testing and automation.
* Hands\-on experience with Appium, Selenium, and JIRA.
* Good knowledge of Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Basic understanding of Android Studio, ADB, Xcode, iOS Simulator, and Android Emulator.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, JSON, Postman, and API testing.
* Experience with real Android and iOS devices is preferred.
* Good problem\-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.

Pay: From ₹200,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Hiring Flutter Developer
description:
**Flutter Developer**

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Location:** Noida  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office

**About the Role**

We are looking for a passionate and skilled **Flutter Developer** to join our technology team. The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing cross\-platform mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain high\-quality mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**.
* Build responsive and user\-friendly interfaces for Android and iOS.
* Convert UI/UX designs into functional mobile applications.
* Integrate **REST APIs, third\-party APIs, and backend services**.
* Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
* Debug and resolve application issues and performance bottlenecks.
* Conduct application testing and ensure smooth functionality across devices.
* Work closely with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and other team members.
* Participate in code reviews and follow development best practices.
* Stay updated with the latest Flutter, Dart, and mobile development trends.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **Flutter and Dart**.
* Understanding of **Android/iOS application development**.
* Experience with REST APIs and JSON.
* Knowledge of Git/GitHub or other version\-control systems.
* Understanding of responsive UI design.
* Basic knowledge of databases and backend integration.
* Good problem\-solving and debugging skills.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with **Firebase** (Authentication, Firestore, Cloud Messaging).
* Knowledge of state management such as **Provider, Riverpod, Bloc, or GetX**.
* Experience with publishing applications on **Google Play Store/App Store**.
* Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

Education

* B.Tech/B.E./MCA/BCA or any relevant degree in Computer Science/IT.
* Freshers with strong Flutter projects or internship experience can also apply.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on real\-world mobile applications.
* Learning and professional growth opportunities.
* Collaborative and supportive work environment.
* Exposure to modern mobile development technologies.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹65,447\.54 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Flutter Developer Internship
description:
**Flutter Developer Intern**

**Location:** Noida  
**Employment Type:** Internship  
**Working Days:** Mon to Sat  
**Work Mode:** Full Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated **Flutter Developer Intern** who is interested in mobile app development and eager to gain hands\-on experience building cross\-platform applications using Flutter and Dart.

The intern will work closely with our development team to develop, test, debug, and improve mobile applications for Android and iOS.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain mobile applications using **Flutter and Dart**.
* Assist in building responsive and user\-friendly UI screens.
* Convert UI/UX designs into functional Flutter applications.
* Integrate APIs and work with backend services.
* Debug and resolve application issues and technical bugs.
* Perform testing and ensure application quality and performance.
* Collaborate with developers, designers, and other team members.
* Participate in code reviews and follow development best practices.
* Stay updated with Flutter, Dart, and mobile development trends.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of **Flutter and Dart**.
* Understanding of mobile application development concepts.
* Familiarity with **REST APIs and JSON** is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of **Git/GitHub**.
* Good understanding of object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Ability to troubleshoot and debug basic technical issues.
* Good communication and problem\-solving skills.

**Eligibility**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed **B.Tech/B.E./BCA/MCA**.
* Freshers and candidates with **0–1 year of experience** are welcome to apply.

What You’ll Gain

* Hands\-on experience in real\-world mobile application development.
* Exposure to the complete app development lifecycle.
* Mentorship from experienced developers.
* Opportunity to work on live projects.
* Practical experience with Flutter, APIs, Git, and modern development practices.

**To Apply: Share your CV on hr@blackbulltechnosoft.com along with your GitHub/portfolio link and details of any Flutter projects you have worked on.**

Pay: ₹14,397\.46 \- ₹65,447\.54 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
